title: Chapter 9 — AI Quiz: Security, Privacy & Data Integrity
instructions: Original AI-authored practice, not an official Cambridge or teacher paper. Answer all questions; written responses are self-marked using the guidance after submission. You can retake the quiz.
description: Original chapter practice: multiple-choice and written questions with self-marking guidance.

questions.text: Which control helps verify a user’s identity?
Explain the difference between authentication and authorisation.

answer.text: Authorisation determines what an authenticated user may access or do.
Check the sender and destination independently; do not trust unexpected links or attachments.
Verify unexpected requests through a known contact channel.

questions.text: Explain how a checksum can detect data corruption.

answer.text: A checksum is calculated from data before transmission or storage.
Recalculate it on receipt and compare; a mismatch indicates corruption.

questions.text: Describe two features of a strong password policy.

answer.text: Require long, unique passwords or passphrases.
Prevent reuse of compromised passwords or use a password manager and multi-factor authentication.
